description_en: Modifies the attributes of a BGP peer
description_zh: 调用ModifyBgpPeerAttribute接口修改BGP邻居的属性
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-bgp-peer-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bgp-peer-id bgp-m5eoyp2mwegk8ce9v0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBgpPeerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer belongs. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要修改属性的BGP邻居所在BGP组的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP peer whose attributes you want to modify
parameters.name: bgp_peer_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要修改属性的BGP邻居所在BGP组的ID。
parameters.name: bgp_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the BGP peer
parameters.name: peer_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD). Valid values:

true: enables BFD.

false (default): does not enable BFD
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启BFD功能，取值：

true：开启BFD功能。

false（默认值）：不开启BFD功能
parameters.name: enable_bfd

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The BFD hop count. Valid values: 1 to 255.

This parameter is required when BFD is enabled.
Enter the BFD hop count, which specifies the maximum number of devices that data passes through from the source to the destination. You can configure different hop counts based on the actual physical link conditions.

If you use BFD in a multi-cloud environment or a direct fiber connection topology where no bridging devices exist, change the default BFD hop count from 255 to 1
parameters.help_zh:
BFD跳数。取值范围：1~255。

选择开启BFD功能时，需要配置此参数。
输入BFD跳数，即数据从源端到目标端传输时经过的最大设备数量。您可以根据真实的物理链路因素配置不同的跳数。

当您在多云环境或光纤直连组网中使用BFD，中间无任何桥接设备时，则需要将BFD的默认跳数从255改成1
parameters.name: bfd_multi_hop
